note: Resolved final icon set from the operator's icon-rename.json (splits applied, shared icons merged, chests = actual chest per rarity, prism = generic rarity concept). Drives build-icon-manifest.mjs → seeds + rosters + export. `prompt` is the gen subject; `assetKeys` are the registry keys the icon serves; `dynamic` = placeholder now, real per-context art later; `keep` = don't (re)generate, leave existing art.
